title: Typed semantic VisualImprovementPlan executor on the real PC.4 project
purpose: Prove that the reusable visual plan can drive a trusted bounded Blender adapter without project-specific proposal code, then rerender the three evidence-bound views for model visual A/B review.

typedAdapters.semantics: Keyframe hide_render CONSTANT for every plan target across only the bound shot range, retaining its prior state immediately outside the shot.
Use the packet camera bound to the operation shot and widen its lens by a deterministic 12 percent, below the plan maximum of 15 percent; camera transforms are unchanged.

Within the plan target set, select mesh targets with at least 400 polygons as primitive primary forms, reduce each primary form to a mechanical core and derive at least three armor/core/ring layers from its evaluated bounding box and transform.
Choose the maximum-volume plan target as the anchor and derive at least seven brow, cheek, jaw and crest layers from its camera-facing bounding box; no object name is used for geometric placement.
For each plan target, derive at least three sparse camera-facing panel or vent layers from its evaluated bounding box; no external asset is introduced.

stopRules: Stop before Blender if context, plan, packet, source or binary identity differs.
Stop before save if any plan target or shot camera is missing, an operation is unknown, an adapter exceeds its plan parameter, or a protected light/camera transform changes.
Stop after the three review PNGs until direct visual inspection; do not render a full sequence on machine counts alone.
A visually worse or still-insufficient result is a valid FAIL and must be retained.
nonClaims: PC4-VX1 does not prove every future plan treatment or asset style.
Procedural typed geometry is not equivalent to a production character artist.
Machine geometry counts cannot override direct screenshot visual review.
PC.3 human review remains pending and separate.
